item.title: 'Stopping the killing is key’: Volodymyr Zelenskyy urges Russia to halt strikes; calls Moscow's refusal to accept ceasefire 'complicating situation'
item.description: President Zelenskyy stated Russia's rejection of a ceasefire complicates ending the three-year war, emphasizing that halting the killings is crucial for peace. He is preparing for a meeting with President Trump in DC to discuss necessary steps for resolution.

item.title: ‘Incredibly isolated’: New Zealand mom and son freed after weeks in US immigration detention – who is she?
item.description: Sarah Shaw, a New Zealand citizen living in the U.S., and her son were detained for over three weeks due to a travel permit error after a trip to Canada. Despite her work permit renewal, Shaw mistakenly believed her travel authorization was also extended.

item.description: Tom Brady's rumored connection with Sydney Sweeney, sparked at Jeff Bezos' wedding, has reportedly attracted attention from English football players. Numerous players from teams like Manchester United, Liverpool, and Arsenal are allegedly flooding Sweeney's DMs with date offers. However, Sweeney, recently single after breaking up with her fiance, seems focused on her career and is avoiding these advances.

item.title: UAEU and IIT Madras Zanzibar develop AI-based framework to forecast malaria outbreaks
item.description: Researchers from UAEU and IIT Madras Zanzibar have developed an AI-powered framework to predict malaria outbreaks with high accuracy. Integrating neural networks, mathematical modelling, and climate variables, the tool enhances real-time risk assessment. Published in Scientific Reports, the study aims to support early interventions in malaria-prone regions, especially sub-Saharan Africa, which bears 94% of global cases.

item.title: Pak floods leave 344 dead: Helicopter crash, mass funerals, widespread destruction deepen crisis
item.description: Northern Pakistan is reeling from devastating flash floods triggered by intense monsoon rains, resulting in at least 344 fatalities in just 48 hours. The Buner district is the hardest hit, with rescue operations severely hampered by washed-out roads and ongoing heavy rainfall. With more rain expected, officials fear the situation will worsen in the climate-vulnerable nation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US proposes 'Nato-style' security guarantee for Ukraine; Putin signals settlement — what it means
item.description: The United States is considering security guarantees for Ukraine. This would mirror Nato's collective defense. However, Ukraine would not formally join the alliance. The proposal follows discussions between Donald Trump, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and European leaders. Trump met with Vladimir Putin in Alaska. Zelenskyy will visit Washington for talks with Trump. They will discuss ending the war.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ukraine-Russia war: EU leaders back Zelenskyy’s right to choose alliances; push for continued sanctions on Moscow
item.description: European leaders affirmed that Russia cannot dictate Ukraine's alliances. This came after talks between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin failed to end the Ukraine war. Europe pledged to support Ukraine's right to choose its future. Trump aimed for a deal, but key issues remained unresolved. Putin welcomed the talks and called for cooperation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ukraine-Russia war: No ceasefire, straight to peace deal? Donald Trump sets lofty goal; to meet Zelenskyy, may talk to Putin again 'if all works out'
item.description: Following a meeting in Alaska, President Trump announced his preference for a direct peace agreement to end the Russia-Ukraine war, rather than a ceasefire. Zelenskyy is scheduled to visit Washington D.C. on Monday, with a potential meeting with Putin to follow if discussions progress positively. Both leaders have expressed openness to negotiations, signaling a potential path toward resolving the conflict.

item.title: ‘Alarming’: British Airways pilot left cockpit door open mid-flight for family; grounded
item.description: A British Airways pilot faced suspension after allegedly leaving the cockpit door open during a Heathrow to New York flight. The pilot reportedly allowed family members into the cockpit, raising security concerns among crew and passengers. The incident led to the cancellation of the return flight, disrupting travel for many.
